final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.location, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount * 1.0, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.location), ranked AS (SELECT link_to_event, location, avg_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY avg_ratio DESC) AS location_rank FROM grouped) SELECT link_to_event, location, avg_ratio, location_rank FROM ranked WHERE location_rank <= 3
